A '''medcenter''' was in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Adascopolis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]. In approximately [[3963 BBY]], [[Jarael]] visited the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] to have a [[Blood/Legends|blood]] sample tested.<ref name="KotOR 16" />
